// Regression: Flux formerly reported inference errors at count() and the for loop.
// No shared ownership types are involved. Minimal regression reduction.
fn consume<I: IntoIterator<Item = u32>>(input: I)
where
    I::IntoIter: ExactSizeIterator,
{
    let values = input.into_iter();
    if values.len() == 0 {
        assert_eq!(values.count(), 0);
        return;
    }
    for value in values {
        let _: u32 = value;
    }
}
fn main() {
    consume([1u32, 2]);
}
